remarks: Welcome to this beautifully expanded and meticulously renovated Cape Cod-style home, nestled on a quiet, family-friendly street in the heart of Cos Cob. Boasting five spacious bedrooms including a large primary suite and four full bathrooms, this home perfectly blends classic charm with modern amenities. The heart of the home is a stunning custom gourmet kitchen, seamlessly connected to a sun-filled family room, ideal for entertaining or everyday living. Step outside to a covered deck complete with a cozy fireplace and outdoor TV, creating a true all-season retreat. Enjoy the privacy of a large, fenced-in yard, perfect for play or relaxation. Additional features include an attached two-car garage and a prime location within the highly sought-after North Street School district.
